title: LocalAIModelContract
description: Schema definitions for the Local AI Model Integration Layer (AIModelInput and AIModelResponse) for on-device natural-language coaching

AIModelInput.description: Privacy-preserving structured evidence payload passed from Insight Engine to Local AI Model

currentTask.description: Category or type of task currently engaged (e.g. coding, writing, meeting, planning)

contextSwitches.description: Count of recent app/task context switches in the active window

context.description: Sanitized physical context label (e.g. Home Office, Cafe, Library)

peakWindow.description: User's calibrated peak productivity time window (e.g. 09:00 - 11:00)

isInPeakWindow.description: Whether current evaluation time falls within the user's peak window

riskLevel.description: Operational risk of fatigue, abandonment, or context disruption

confidence.description: Statistical confidence in current telemetry calibration

detectedTrigger.description: Primary behavioral friction trigger identified by the Insight Engine

facts.description: Sanitized bulleted factual observations driving this evaluation

AIModelResponse.description: Structured natural-language coaching output returned by the Local AI Model

message.description: 1-2 sentence supportive, actionable natural-language coaching guidance

reason.description: Clear explainable evidence driving the coaching recommendation

action.description: Specific concrete next step for the user

confidence.description: Confidence level of the generated coaching response

provider.description: Identifier of model provider (e.g. fallback, gemma-2b, tinyllama)

isFallback.description: True if response was produced by the deterministic fallback coach
